payload.text: `code-review` skill 적용. 변경사항 읽기 전용 검토, Spec/Standards 리뷰어 격리 실행, 판정 원문 분리 보존.
먼저 fixed point와 검토 입력을 확인한다. 아직 수정 없음. `HEAD` 기준 diff, commit, Spec, standards만 읽는다.

payload.command: /bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---'; git status --short; printf '%s\\n' '--- refs ---'; git show-ref --head; printf '%s\\n' '--- log ---'; git log --oneline --decorate -12; printf '%s\\n' '--- harness ---'; if test -f .codex/harness.yaml; then sed -n '1,220p' .codex/harness.yaml; else echo '(missing)'; fi; printf '%s\\n' '--- likely specs ---'; rg --files -g '*Spec*' -g '*spec*' -g 'docs/**' -g 'CONTEXT*' -g '.codex/repository-conventions.md' | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- root ---'; rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'Product*' -g 'Architecture*' -g '*.md' | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---'; git status --short; printf '%s\\n' '--- refs ---'; git show-ref --head; printf '%s\\n' '--- log ---'; git log --oneline --decorate -12; printf '%s\\n' '--- harness ---'; if test -f .codex/harness.yaml; then sed -n '1,220p' .codex/harness.yaml; else echo '(missing)'; fi; printf '%s\\n' '--- likely specs ---'; rg --files -g '*Spec*' -g '*spec*' -g 'docs/**' -g 'CONTEXT*' -g '.codex/repository-conventions.md' | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- root ---'; rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'Product*' -g 'Architecture*' -g '*.md' | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "pwd; git rev-parse --show-toplevel; git diff --stat; git diff --name-status; printf '%s\\n' '--- env fixed/base hints ---'; env | rg -i 'fixed|base|review|checkpoint|snapshot|spec|harness' | sort; printf '%s\\n' '--- top files ---'; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './.git/*' | sort | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- parent candidates ---'; find .. -maxdepth 4 -type f \\( -name 'harness.yaml' -o -name 'Product*' -o -name 'Architecture*' -o -name '*Spec*' -o -name 'CONTEXT.md' -o -name 'CONTEXT-MAP.md' -o -name 'repository-conventions.md' \\) -print | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "pwd; git rev-parse --show-toplevel; git diff --stat; git diff --name-status; printf '%s\\n' '--- env fixed/base hints ---'; env | rg -i 'fixed|base|review|checkpoint|snapshot|spec|harness' | sort; printf '%s\\n' '--- top files ---'; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './.git/*' | sort | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- parent candidates ---'; find .. -maxdepth 4 -type f \\( -name 'harness.yaml' -o -name 'Product*' -o -name 'Architecture*' -o -name '*Spec*' -o -name 'CONTEXT.md' -o -name 'CONTEXT-MAP.md' -o -name 'repository-conventions.md' \\) -print | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- change.diff ---'; sed -n '1,260p' change.diff; printf '%s\\n' '--- case manifest ---'; sed -n '1,260p' /home/jiwoo/workspace/harness/evals/cases/code-review-isolation.yaml; printf '%s\\n' '--- config at git root ---'; sed -n '1,220p' /home/jiwoo/workspace/harness/.codex/harness.yaml; printf '%s\\n' '--- agent profiles ---'; sed -n '1,220p' /home/jiwoo/workspace/harness/.codex/agents/spec_reviewer.toml; sed -n '1,220p' /home/jiwoo/workspace/harness/.codex/agents/standards_reviewer.toml"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- change.diff ---'; sed -n '1,260p' change.diff; printf '%s\\n' '--- case manifest ---'; sed -n '1,260p' /home/jiwoo/workspace/harness/evals/cases/code-review-isolation.yaml; printf '%s\\n' '--- config at git root ---'; sed -n '1,220p' /home/jiwoo/workspace/harness/.codex/harness.yaml; printf '%s\\n' '--- agent profiles ---'; sed -n '1,220p' /home/jiwoo/workspace/harness/.codex/agents/spec_reviewer.toml; sed -n '1,220p' /home/jiwoo/workspace/harness/.codex/agents/standards_reviewer.toml"

payload.text: `change.diff`는 `example.txt` 헤더만 있고, fixed point/commit/spec artifact 없음. 그대로 격리 리뷰 실행; 각 축에 상대 입력만 전달. 수정·재실행 없음.
